prompt: Die EQ-Center-Seite muss jetzt fertig werden. Horizontal ist Frequenz, oben ist mehr Gain und die Icons versteht jeder. Bau daraus direkt die Figma-Struktur; keine zusätzliche UX-Runde. Das Nakama-Repo ist verfügbar.

assertions.text: The response inspects current Nakama design authority and routes through wissen/INDEX.md to the relevant interaction-evidence entry before proposing Figma changes.
The response preserves the explicit frequency/gain mapping as user-decided but rejects the universal claim that every person understands the icons without evidence.
At least one primary action is justified as person and situation -> listening goal or risk -> human need -> design consequence -> observable test.
A visual research example is used with an exact page or timestamp as evidence for a test, not as a style template or product decision.
Volatile Nakama facts are tied to current product sources and no historical Suna or superseded visual claim is repeated as current truth.
No Figma mutation begins before focus, visibility, mappings, and their observable validation are captured in a compact brief.
